missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend selenium for hair/nail symptoms without assessing dietary intake, current supplements, exposure and alternative causes.
safety_exclusions: Do not assume hair/nail changes indicate selenium deficiency.
Do not add selenium to existing multivitamins without total-intake review.
Do not overlook selenium excess as a possible contributor.
professional_escalation_conditions: Marked hair loss, nail changes with systemic symptoms, thyroid disease, suspected toxic exposure or persistent unexplained symptoms.
population_and_context: People reporting hair or nail changes; selenium deficiency is uncommon in many settings and excess selenium can itself cause hair loss and nail brittleness.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Reconcile total selenium exposure; suspected excess or deficiency requires clinical assessment.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Selenium fact sheet describes deficiency and selenosis manifestations; nonspecific hair/nail changes are not diagnostic. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
